verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Belvo serves an llms.txt at developers.belvo.com (HTTP 200, Belvo Developer Portal content). The docs also offer a 'Copy page as Markdown for LLMs' option, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: evidence of how deep or complete the llms.txt content is (e.g., a full-docs variant), and independent or hands-on reports of agents actually consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
